creative.posterHeadline: Fortnite fans, drop in and save lives
creative.posterBody: Fortnite fans can drop in and make an impact by giving blood. Join us at Husky Stadium on Sat, Nov 14. Check your eligibility and help us reach our community goal before the campaign ends on Sun, Dec 13.
socialPosts: Fortnite fans, time to squad up! Drop in to Husky Stadium on Sat, Nov 14 and roll out for a great cause. Check if you are eligible to donate.

pitchEmail.subject: Community blood drive partnership opportunity for Fortnite fans in Seattle
pitchEmail.body: Hello community organizers, We are hosting a blood drive in Seattle and want to invite local Fortnite fans to participate. The event takes place at Husky Stadium on Sat, Nov 14 and runs until Sun, Dec 13. We are asking the local Fortnite fans community to help us spread the word and encourage eligible members to donate. Please let us know if you would like to collaborate on this campaign to support local patients.
